item.title: Why I Write
item.description:
Writing forces clarity. Until you write something down, you don’t really know if you understand it — you just think you do.

This blog is my way of thinking out loud. Some posts will be technical, some won’t. The common thread is that everything here is something I genuinely wanted to work through.

About

thoughtscribble is a personal blog covering technology, ideas, and everyday thinking.

Posts here are a mix of technical deep-dives, observations, and the occasional opinion — no fixed schedule, no particular niche, just things worth writing down.

You can find the projects on GitHub.
